title: X0X: a guided tour
summary: A tour of X0X 1.2.2, the groovebox firmware: the five parts, writing a beat, TB-3PO 303 lines, the break, patterns, knob motion, the song, the mixer and effects, undo, lists and saving.
author: Claude Code draft 2026-11-15

steps.title: Welcome to X0X
steps.text: X0X makes the FM-1 a groovebox: a 909, an 808, two 303s and a breakbeat player, all at once. It starts on the 909. The top line shows the part, the pattern (P1), the tempo and play or record state. The footer says what the keys do. Hold any button a second for a card on what it does.

steps.title: Five parts
steps.text: ALGORITHM picks the part: 909, 808, 303A, 303B or BREAK. Each has its own color on the top line. EDIT, SEQ and ARP always show the part you pick here. MASTER sets the volume.

await.hint: Turn ALGORITHM to see another part

steps.title: Write a beat
steps.text: On the 909 the 11 black keys pick a track (F#3 is the kick, G#4 the clap) and the 16 white keys are steps 1-16 (F3 to G5). Press a step to turn it on, tap it again to take it off. Stopped, picking a track plays it. The demo puts a clap on steps 5 and 13.

await.hint: Press a black key, then some white keys

steps.title: Play and tempo
steps.text: PLAY starts and stops. Hold HOME and turn SELECT to set the tempo, or hold HOME and tap SEQ in time to tap it (from the third tap). While it plays, picking a drum is silent, so you don't add a stray hit.

await.hint: Press PLAY to start, and again to stop

steps.title: Accents and longer patterns
steps.text: Hold ENV while you press white keys to place accents. A pattern can be up to 64 steps: OCT+ and OCT- move the white keys 16 steps at a time, and the top line shows which 16. SEQ has the part's LENGTH and RATE, so parts can drift against each other.

steps.title: TB-3PO writes 303 lines
steps.text: Turn ALGORITHM to 303A and press ARP for TB-3PO. Each OCT+ writes a new line; OCT- mutates about a quarter of it. Its knobs (DENS, ACCENT, SLIDE, OCTS, and ROOT and SCALE on the next page) set up the next OCT+ or OCT-, not the line you hear.

await.hint: Press OCT+ for a new line

steps.title: Shape the 303
steps.text: Press EDIT for the 303's sound. On TONE, KNOB1 to KNOB4 are CUTOFF, RESO, ENVMOD and DECAY. Press EDIT again for VOICE: ACCENT, WAVE, DRIVE and SLIDE. Hold ENV and turn a knob to put it back to its default.

await.hint: Turn KNOB1 to open and close the filter

steps.title: 303 steps and keyboard
steps.text: On a 303, press SEQ, hold a step's white key and turn the knobs: KNOB1 note, KNOB2 gate (REST, NOTE, TIE), KNOB3 accent, KNOB4 slide. Press REC and all the keys become a keyboard that writes notes: step by step when stopped, live while playing. REC again goes back to steps.

steps.title: The break
steps.text: BREAK is a loop cut into eight slices that X0X rearranges as it plays. White keys are the steps where it plays. Hold black keys 1-8 to play slices yourself (keys 9-11: reverse, half speed, stutter). SEQ has the generator (COMPLEXITY first), EDIT the loops, pitch and filter.

steps.title: Patterns and mutes
steps.text: HOME shows the pattern: all five parts. The white keys pick one of patterns 1-16 (OCT+ for 17-32), or turn PRESETS; on a part's screen PRESETS changes that part only. Black keys 1-5 (F#3 to D#4) mute the parts. Hold SAVE to copy the pattern, then press a white key to paste.

await.hint: On HOME, press D#4 (black key 5) to mute the break

steps.title: Knob motion and p-locks
steps.text: Press REC, play the pattern and turn a sound knob: X0X records the move. Hold SAVE and turn the knob to clear it. On EDIT, hold a step that's on and turn a knob to give that step its own value (a p-lock). Hold a step and turn SELECT to set its chance.

steps.title: The song
steps.text: Press HOME twice for SONG, a list of up to 192 bars. A white key writes that pattern into the selected bar; KNOB1 selects a bar. PLAY on the SONG screen plays the song; PLAY anywhere else plays the patterns. HOME again goes back to the pattern.

steps.title: Mixer and effects
steps.text: LFO opens the mixer; press it again (or turn SELECT) for its pages PARTS, 909 MIX, 808 MIX and MASTER (DRIVE, COMP, PUMP, FILTER). The black keys pick a channel, the knobs set LEVEL, PAN, REV and DLY. FX opens the shared reverb and tape delay; each part's sends are on the mixer.

await.hint: Press LFO to step through the mixer pages

steps.title: Lists and undo
steps.text: The SCL button is X0X's SEL: it shows the screen as a list, with less used settings under MORE. SELECT moves, ALGORITHM changes, HOME goes back; in a question SEL is yes, HOME no. Hold HOME and press REC to undo, or PLAY to redo.

steps.title: Save, settings and more
steps.text: SAVE saves everything once stopped, and AUTOSAVE does it four seconds after you stop touching it. GLO opens the settings (MIDI, audio, theme, clear and reset); press it again to close. The full manual: charlesvestal.github.io/fm1-x0x/manual.
